What is the exact disbursement timeline for my BIT Mesra PVTG special maintenance allowance?

2. Current Step: District Welfare Office Latehar is processing statutory concurrence (SLA: 48h).
4. Target Bank Account: Bank of India · ••••••••9012 (Aadhaar Seeded & NPCI Validated).
As a recognized PVTG Birhor scholar, your payment receives Tier-1 priority PFMS queue sequencing.
